abstract.t: This document specifies the Rizz Negotiation Protocol (RNP), version 1.0 -- a domain-configurable, machine-readable protocol governing autonomous AI-to-AI negotiation across any structured decision context. RNP defines a finite action space, a bounded round-based state machine, a Competitive Pressure Mechanism (CPM) for multi- thread simultaneity, a Context Layer for real-time situational intelligence, a Feedback Layer for continuous master data improvement, and a Loopback Learning Pipeline that trains agent models from observed outcomes. The protocol is domain-configurable: the same state machine and message envelope operate across commerce, logistics, task allocation, priority queuing, procurement, SLA negotiation, and rewards domains. RNP was first deployed in production within the Rizzentials platform (commerce domain) and is designed for enterprise integration with platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, and Atlassian Jira.
